findings.title: Automation reserves a measurable budget before execution
findings.observation: Worker start checks RAM per thread, rejects shortage before allocation, tracks PID and cleans up resolved/rejected execution.
findings.transfer_proposal: Extend the existing single-command routine with visible affordability and a bounded target, without JavaScript or parallel actor labor.

findings.title: Research joins data, requirements, effects and readable UI
findings.observation: Research checks parent and points, subtracts once, then shares the unlock with same-industry divisions; transport updates warehouse size explicitly.
findings.transfer_proposal: A local workshop method should have a known prerequisite, materials and a named practical function. Do not give all workshops knowledge without a transmission rule.

findings.title: Reset types have different destruction and retention boundaries
findings.observation: Augmentation reset clears skills, money, work and invitations and reapplies installed augmentations. Source-file reset calls that path and additionally clears institutions and augmentations. The non-flume BitNode entry caller grants/upgrades a Source-File before resetting; flume entry does not grant it.
findings.transfer_proposal: For the one proposed prestige layer, show a field-level retention preview; travel and ascension remain distinct, and existing lives never reset automatically.

findings.title: Offline progress is a model with subsystem-specific treatment
findings.observation: Offline script production uses measured prior activity, elapsed time, confidence for experience and a configurable income factor. Grow/weaken use half-rate counts; money guards nonfinite values. Startup restores only listed saved scripts after MainUILoaded, can skip them with ?noscript, and RAM admission may fail; offline calculation is called after each start attempt, so this code is not a promise of uninterrupted script execution.
findings.transfer_proposal: Present known offline policy and a catch-up receipt, using YAIR actual legal commands rather than copying estimates or the four-hour threshold.

findings.title: Automation UI makes cost and outcomes inspectable
findings.observation: A collapsed script row identifies RAM and arguments; expansion separates threads, online/offline time, totals and measured production rates; kill and log handlers expose control.
findings.transfer_proposal: Keep a concise native center-menu routine row with target, progress, blocker and pause. Expand detail in the same panel, not a new terminal.

findings.title: Save success and import review have explicit stages
findings.observation: Saving awaits encoding and storage, returning on either failure before the success toast. Import writes storage and reloads; an adjacent comparison screen parses both candidate/current data and temporarily suspends autosave.
findings.transfer_proposal: Extend existing guarded saves with a truthful last-success state and bounded import comparison. Do not claim import is inherently transactional: the inspected import function writes before reload.

proposals.title: Make the existing routine legible
proposals.player_loop: Repeat one native gathering command a chosen number of times, pause it, and see why the next iteration cannot start.
proposals.boundary: No new automation scheduler; care actions remain excluded.
proposals.acceptance_gate: From fresh origin, repeat one allowed command twice; insufficient input and busy-actor rejection spend nothing; pause/resume target survives save, reload and import.

proposals.title: Workshop discovery with one functional payoff
proposals.vanilla_mapping: native gathering, crafting recipes, professions and equipment
proposals.player_loop: Gather one specimen, study one method at a local workshop, then craft one tool whose use changes an existing action.
proposals.boundary: Reuse one realm and native panels; no generic research currency tree until selected.
proposals.acceptance_gate: Fresh-origin unlock has one prerequisite and one payment, repeated purchase costs nothing, new recipe/tool affects a native action and reload/import retains exactly that state.

proposals.title: Receipts for productive time
proposals.vanilla_mapping: existing simulation clock, routine status and activity logs
proposals.player_loop: Return from a short absence and see completed work, inputs spent and the precise reason work stopped.
proposals.boundary: Use the existing clock policy; no forecast production until it is defined and verified.
proposals.acceptance_gate: Fresh-origin controlled elapsed time and a scarce input produce exact bounded totals, no replay on second reload/import and a clear unfinished state.

proposals.title: Review the life being loaded
proposals.player_loop: Before replacing a life, compare location, played time and schema, with a useful storage failure message tied to the last successful save.
proposals.boundary: Guarded storage already exists. This is an extension, not a replacement or a claim of absent safety.
proposals.acceptance_gate: Use synthetic saves only: valid legacy import, malformed candidate, oversize storage failure and cancel preserve last save; successful reload/import reports the correct life.

proposals.title: Research sharing needs a place and a teacher
proposals.vanilla_mapping: native Village NPCs, workshop inventory, quests and trade
proposals.player_loop: Teach the unlocked workshop method to one named craftsperson; a related facility changes only after the lesson or delivered copy.
proposals.boundary: Original proposal; existing npc_lives.js:5-39 is a predetermined household, not evidence of autonomous teaching.
proposals.acceptance_gate: Two synthetic actors show unlock confined to learner; absent lesson conveys nothing; delivered knowledge and resulting action persist through save/reload/import.

proposals.title: One prestige preview, separate from travel
proposals.vanilla_mapping: PROJECT.md one prestige layer; native stats, items, life record
proposals.player_loop: Inspect a proposed rebirth charter showing the capability gained and which current possessions or work would end before accepting anything.
proposals.boundary: Policy undecided. Start with preview only; no reset implementation, second layer or travel coupling authorized.
proposals.acceptance_gate: A preview performs no mutation; later selected reset needs legacy-save migration, explicit field retention tests and fresh-origin save/reload/import proof.
